scenes.setting: Quelaag Club: a pregnancy dated to the week of the nightmares, a dark room with running water — Klein concludes Aaron's wife carries Will Auceptin, a Snake of Mercury restarting his cycle — and outside, an unnatural wind cuts southeast through Backlund's fog
scenes.text_anchor: He suspected that his wife was carrying Will Auceptin, a Snake of Mercury!

scenes.setting: In a carriage on the street: the Mandated Punishers have 'found' Jason — two of them dead, Cardinal Ace Snake himself in pursuit (that wind) — and Arrodes shows the man boarding a riverboat; Ikanser pays for the answer with a mortifying question, and Klein plants the doubt: the Desire Apostle and Jason Beria may not be the same person
scenes.text_anchor: What we are looking for is that Desire Apostle, not Jason Beria.

scenes.setting: A room-sized carriage off King's Avenue: Duke Negan plans to court Earl Hall over the Poor Law while guarding the property qualification, then slips off to his favorite young mistress — mummy-powder tonic drunk, Ace Snake's blue conch at his throat — and the carriage stops at a mansion with a glass greenhouse full of bright red roses
scenes.text_anchor: there was a glass greenhouse filled with bright red roses
